Video games, brought to life

TorqBall

It's basically Rocket League — with RC buggies · The flagship

Teams push a big glowing ball into the goal. Zero skill wall, pure team energy — it turns a total first-timer into a cheering team in 30 seconds. This is the poster and the reel that sells the whole brand.

How it plays

  • 2v2 or 3v3 on a boarded pitch — the walls keep ball + cars in, rebounds are the game.
  • Push a big light-up ball into the lit goal; most goals in 2–3 min wins.
  • A tournament: group stage → knockouts → a crowned Grand Final.
  • No positions, no offside — just chase the ball. The overhead cam never stops eating.

The playlist

One boarded pitch, Rocket-League-style modes.

Standard

2v2 / 3v3 into goals — the default.

Duel

1v1 skill showcase — the hype final.

Big Party

4v4 / 6v6, glorious scrum — comedy content.

Rumble

Power-ups everywhere — the boost system turned to 11.

Hoops

Ramp-basket goal — push the ball up + in (stretch).

Puck

Swap the ball for a sliding disc (stretch).

Our own boosts

Not raw speed (cars are capped) — a boost changes the car, the goal, or the lane. Earn one on a boost pad, use it, lose it.

Plow

Wide bumper — move the ball + bulldoze rivals.

Scoop

Curved lip — lift and carry the ball a little.

Grabber

Velcro face — the ball sticks so you can dribble it.

Turbo

A speed burst via a boost lane — never an unsafe hack.

Magnet

The goal you're attacking widens for ~20s.

Boost pads

Drive over to earn — powered by TorqCapture's zone tech.

See it move

Gated on the ball + the boards. Our cars can't fly or boost, so it's ground car-football — and it lives or dies on a big light ball a capped car can actually shove, and a boarded pitch that keeps play in. A cheap ball test + a board build settle it.
